description: This file contains utility functions for Playwright browser automation, including waiting for request completion, calling functions on pages without tracing, generating date-based filenames, and waiting for events with timeout and abort capabilities.

methods.name: waitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for a callback to complete while monitoring network requests, and waits for page load if navigation requests are detected.

methods.name: callOnPageNoTrace
methods.description: Executes a callback on a Playwright page object without tracing, using internal API wrapping.

methods.name: dateAsFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename string based on the current date and provided extension.

methods.name: eventWaiter
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on a Playwright page with a timeout and provides an abort function.
